Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out to the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are the openers for Ireland. Junaid Siddique to start with the ball. Here we go ...
... THE CHASE ...
Right then! Ireland need 179 to win. It is Ireland's batting against UAE's spinners. Stay tuned to find out how the chase unfolds.

Rohan Mustafa is up for a quick chat. Says that it looked like a good batting track and once set, you need to make the most of it. Tells that he is happy with the total and praises the knock of Kashif Daud. Feels it's not easy to chase and they have some good spinners in their team. Reckons that if they bowl in the good areas, they will win.

Ireland looked a bit tired. Their fielding was not too great while there were too many dropped catches. They gave plenty of freebies as well and were ordinary for most parts of the innings. Apart from Craig Young, who picked a 4-wicket haul, and Simi Singh, the rest of the bowlers were inconsistent. They had the chance to finish well but 23 runs from the last over will hurt them.

United Arab Emirates had a good start but the openers fell in quick succession. It was the partnership of 94 runs between Vriitya Aravind and Rohan Mustafa that helped UAE get back on track. The duo played really well with young Vriitya Aravind playing some extraordinary shots. Both fell after scoring brilliant fifties and UAE needed a strong finish. Kashif Daud provided them with that and helped UAE post an above-par total on this pitch.

A massive finish - 23 runs from the final over. Kashif Daud went berserk at the backend and capitalized on the platform provided by the pair of Rohan Mustafa and Vriitya Aravind. They have posted a competitive total on the board and the momentum is on their side as they head for a break.

SIX! High and handsome! Kashif Daud has provided a quickfire finish. Full and around off, right in the slot for the batter, Kashif Daud clears his front leg and towers it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 23 runs from the over, United Arab Emirates have finished on 178/5.
FOUR! Streaky but they all count! Adair digs it in short, around middle and extra pace, Kashif Daud top-edges his attempted pull shot behind the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! This is turning out to be a very expensive over. Short and around leg, slower again, Daud turns and waits before smacking it behind square leg for a boundary.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's driven to the left side of the long off fielder for a couple of runs.
SIX! Dispatched! Slower one, short and on middle, Daud picks it and smokes it over wide long on for a biggie.
Fuller and outside off, Boota goes for a hoick but only drags it to short fine leg. A single.
Who will bowl the final over? It is Mark Adair.
Short again, on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a run.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run. The fielder fumbled and conceded the second run.
Knocks it down to wide long on for two.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers for one.
Another delivery down the leg side, Boota fails to flick this time. They get a leg bye.
Down the leg side, Daud fails to flick and it goes off his pads. They take a leg bye.
Mohammad Boota comes in now.

OUT! Drags it on! The slower one has eventually done the trick. Full and around off, Mustafa clears his front leg and tries to rifle it through the line but it takes the inner edge and hits the stumps behind. Another timely breakthrough for Ireland.
Short and slow around off, Rohan Mustafa walks across the stumps and tries to pull but misses.
FOUR! Rohan Mustafa has decided to tee off. Full and angling away from the batsman, Rohan makes room and lifts it over backward point for a boundary.
Serves it slow and around off, short in length, Rohan Mustafa swings his bat early and misses.
On middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
FIFTY FOR ROHAN, off 39 balls. Fuller in length and outside off, Rohan Mustafa strokes it through point for a single. He knows that the job is not done. A quick raise of the bat from him.
Again gives the charge to a length ball and hits it in the gap at covers for one. 12 from the over.
FOUR! Bang! Josh Little serves it on a shortish length around off, Rohan Mustafa steps down the track, makes room and slaps it in front of square on the off side for a cracking boundary.
Slower one, on a shortish length, again Daud fails to get it away. It goes off his pads towards short fine leg and they take a leg bye.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off hit towards extra cover for one.
Angling down the leg side, Kashif fails to flick it away and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Smashed! Short in length and around middle, Kashif Daud stands tall and pulls it powerfully through square leg for a boundary.
Kashif Daud walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fuller in length, around off and angling in, Basil Hameed walks forward and flicks it aerially towards wide long on. Mark Adair moves across to his right and goes down to complete the catch safely. A quick exit for Basil Hameed and it's the end of a fantastic over from Craig Young, 6 runs, 2 wickets and a dropped catch in it.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and around leg, it's forced down to wide long on for a brisk couple of runs.
Short and wide outside off, Rohan Mustafa camps back to cut but it takes the under-edge and rolls towards short third man. They cross.

DROPPED! Yet another catch is put down in the field. Looks like Ireland had some extra butter in the breakfast. Fuller in length and wide outside off, Rohan Mustafa throws his bat at it and the ball flies over point. George Dockrell comes running across to his right from sweeper cover but fails to take a simple catch. They take a couple of runs.
Full and on middle, Basil Hameed flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Basil Hameed is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! End of a fabulous knock from Vriitya Aravind. He tries to be very cheeky again. Attempts to play the paddle scoop to a full toss in the line of the stumps. Misses and finds the stumps shattered. A vital breakthrough for Ireland as Vriitya Aravind was going all guns blazing.
Another bowling change. Craig Young (2-0-16-1) is back on.
FOUR! Short in length, on middle, Rohan Mustafa plays a forehand tennis shot through wide mid on and the fielder in the deep makes a meal of it. A boundary.
Fifty for Vriitya Aravind! Fearless brand of cricket from Aravind. He is playing with freedom! Length and on off. He drops it to point for a quick single.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Vriitya Aravind misses his pull.
FOUR! WOW! Keep an eye on this guy! He is playing some beautiful shots! Short and outside off, Vriitya Aravind ramps it away over short third man for a boundary.
A fumble and they take two! Short of a length, on middle, pulled away to long on for a couple of runs.
Agan tries to play the same shot but the ball was too close and was on a shorter length as well. He misses.
FOUR! Improvisation from Vriitya Aravind! This is full and outside off. Vriitya Aravind gets across a bit and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Curtis Campher is back into the attack. 2-0-13-0 are his figures thus far.
Singh sees Mustafa coming down the track and serves a full toss way outside off. Mustafa adjusts late and lifts it towards deep point for a brace.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Rohan Mustafa reverse-sweeps it straight to point.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
Tossed up, fuller and on off. Rohan Mustafa thumps it past the bowler and to long off for a single.
Rohan again gives the charge as he comes down the track and slaps this short ball to long off. A little fumble there and a couple of runs are taken.
SIX! BANG! A loopy ball, full and on middle, Rohan comes down the track and whacks it all the way over square leg for a maximum.

Dropped! A length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind chips it aerially and towards long off. The fielder there, Josh Little, charges forward but fumbles as he tries to catch it by going down low. A chance has gone to get a breakthrough. Two taken.
A short ball, on middle Vriitya Aravind evades it.
Around off, Rohan eases it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short of a length, on middle. Rohan Mustafa gets across and goes deep in his crease as he pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind drives it to deep point for a single.

Length and on middle. Rohan Mustafa defends it under his eyes. The ball rolls on the deck and they take a quick run. Mark Adair tries to flick with his boot but misses the stumps at the striker's end.
WIDE! Length ball but down the leg side. Rohan misses his flick.
Mark Adair is back into the attack. Just one over before this and it went for 11 runs.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for a couple of runs.
Flatter and on off. Vriitya Aravind keeps it out.
Shorter and on off. Rohan Mustafa knocks it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and skidding through on the pads. Vriitya Aravind skips down and turns it to square leg for a single.
Flights this one, outside off. Rohan taps it to point for a single.
A slower ball, angling on the pads. Mustafa makes room and looks to work it on the leg side but misses.
A single to end the over! Both the batters are happy to rotate the strike at the moment. A single as this is hit to point.
Shorter and on the pads. Rohan Mustafa looks to pull but misses.
A loopy ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind works it through covers for a single. The 50-run stand comes up!
An appeal for LBW but not given! A flighted ball, full and on middle. Rohan Mustafa looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Given as a run means there was some bat on it.
Too short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Vriitya Aravind slaps it to deep cover. The fielder runs to his right and stops it. Two runs.
Flatter and on middle, Vriitya Aravind goes back and helps it to mid-wicket for a single. At the halfway mark, United Arab Emirates are 74/2.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back.
FOUR! Classy! Loopy and full, landing around off, Vriitya Aravind lofts it inside-out over covers and finds the fence with ease. Beautiful.
Mustafa gives the charge and Simi follows him down the leg side with a flat delivery. It's kept out towards mid-wicket for one. Given as a leg bye.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut towards point for a single.
Lucky there. Full and flighted around leg, Vriitya Aravind stays back to force it through the line but it beats his bat and goes closely past the leg stump.
Loopy and full around middle, Rohan Mustafa works it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Perhaps this one turns the other way. Around middle, Vriitya Aravind tries playing from the crease but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to backward point and they cross.
Full and around leg, eased with soft hands to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Presses forward and pushes it wide of mid off for a run. Some confusion regarding the second run and Rohan Mustafa is sent back.

Almost drags it on! Delany gets this one to go straight on after landing around off, it stays a bit low too, Vriitya Aravind gets back to play but it takes the inner edge and goes past the keeper to fine leg for two.
Flighted and on middle, landing on a fuller length and turning in, Rohan flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Change from both ends as Gareth Delany to bowl now.
Skidding back in from around off again, Mustafa tucks it in the gap at mid-wicket and will get a single.
Skidding in from around off, Rohan works it on the leg side. His partner wants a run but is sent back.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it to covers. Not in the gap.
Loopy and full around off, Mustafa gets forward and defends it back.
Serves it short and on middle, Vriitya Aravind goes on the back foot and punches it down to long on for one.
Flatter and a touch shorter around off, Aravind plays late and guides it wide of short third man for a couple of runs.
Change. Simi Singh is into the attack.
Shortish and outside off, Aravind goes on his toes and runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, played down from the back foot to point.
Delivers it on a length around middle, Rohan Mustafa works it in the gap at mid-wicket and calls for two. He will get only a run.
Short and on middle, Vriitya Aravind plays a mistimed pull shot over square leg. Gets a run.
Drifting down the leg side, nudged down to fine leg for one.
Some acrobatic effort! Angling down the leg side, Aravind whips it down to long leg. It drops in front of Simi Singh and changes direction. He dives to his left to stop the ball. A single is taken.
Another delivery in the zone outside off, Rohan Mustafa shoulders arms. At the end of the Powerplay, United Arab Emirates are 50/2.
In the channel outside off, Rohan Mustafa offers no shot.

Appeal for an lbw! This one starts from middle and angles down, Aravind tries to flick but misses. It pings him on the pads and deflects wide of backward point. The bowler appeals and the batters cross. Given as a leg bye.
Extra pace on this occasion, full and around leg, Vriitya Aravind tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge to covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it gently to cover-point.
SIX! Nailed! Full in length and angling down the leg side, Vriitya Aravind picks it off his pads and powers it behind square leg for a biggie.
This is a touch fuller, on off. Mustafa keeps it out.
Around off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Powered! Length ball, width on offered and Rohan Mustafa slashes it through point for a boundary.
Around middle, on a length. Mustafa knocks it to covers.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Edgy runs! On a length, on off. Rohan Mustafa stays back and looks to defend but the ball nips back a touch and takes the inside edge and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Curtis Campher to bowl now.
Length and on off. Vriitya Aravind hits it to covers. Rohan Mustafa wanted a single but was sent back clearly.
SIX! Some start by Vriitya Aravind! This is short and on middle. Vriitya Aravind hooks it late and all the way over the fine leg fence. First biggie of the innings.
Two wickets in 5 balls and Ireland are on top. In walks Rohan Mustafa to arrest the slide.

OUT! CAUGHT! Now Craig Young gets the wicket and the other opener falls as well. Good start from Ireland. Short of a length, angling on the hips. Chirag whips it nicely but hits it to the longer side of the ground. Shane Getkate stationed at deep square leg takes it easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Shane Getkate b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Young follows Suri on the leg side. He hits it to mid on.
FOUR! Well played! On a length and angling on leg. Chirag backs away and tucks it past mid-wicket and the ball races away to the mid-wicket fence.
Full and on off, pushed to the right of the cover fielder and Paul Stirling puts a dive to stop it. Saved a certain boundary there.
The new batsman is walking in and it's Vriitya Aravind at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Josh Little gets the opening wicket and after a good start, Waseem Muhammad perishes. A length ball, angling outside off. Waseem Muhammad looks to loft it over mid off but it takes the outer half of the bat. Andy Balbirnie, at extra cover, runs across to his right and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Glorious shot! Over-pitched, on middle. Waseem Muhammad on-drives it through mid on for a boundary.
On middle, shorter length. Suri mistimes his pull to mid-wicket for a single. Was in the air but over the fielder inside the ring.
FOUR! Edged away! Short of a length, on off. Chirag looks to hook but gets an under edge, just past the leg stump and away from short fine leg as well. A boundary.
Bangs a length ball, outside off. Chirag looks to slash at it but misses.
Josh Little continues to serve away from the arc, outside off. Suri swings and misses.
On a length, around off. Waseem Muhammad defends it towards covers. 11 coming off the over.
WIDE! Too many extras from Ireland already! Short in length, slanting around leg. Waseem Muhammad misses his pull.
Length and angling on middle. Blocked out.
Length and on off. Waseem Muhammad works it to point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is again on the fuller side, on middle. Waseem Muhammad lifts it nicely over mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Pitches it up, outside off. Waseem Muhammad leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Length ball, straying down the leg side. Waseem Muhammad misses his whip.
Almost a yorker, on middle, pushed to mid on.
WIDE! Fuller ball, bit of swing there, but way down the leg side. Waseem Muhammad misses his flick.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? As always, it's going to be Mark Adair.
FOUR! Streaky and Chirag Suri is off the mark! On a length, outside off. Chirag looks to push but it takes the outside edge and the ball races away to the third man fence.
Josh keeps the same line, outside off. Chirag has a poke at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit to covers.
Fullish delivery, slanting outside off. Chirag Suri drives it straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller, outside off, pushed to point.
Better from Little! Again outside off, on a fuller length. Chirag lets it through.
WIDE! Josh Little starts with a full ball but angling way outside off. Suri leaves it alone and a wide is given.
Time to get underway! Waseem Muhammad and Chirag Suri are the openers for United Arab Emirates.​ Josh Little to steam in with the new ball. One slip in place. Here we go...

Ahmed Raza, the captain of United Arab Emirates, says that he would have bowled as well but the wicket won't change much. Adds that they have spoken to the top order and there is nothing in the morning for the fast bowlers. Informs that they have made one change and the leg spinner, Karthik Meiyappan, is playing today. Shares that they have talked about their fielding and would like to do better in this match.

Andy Balbirnie, the captain of Ireland, says that he is bowling first as it's an early morning start, it's a touch tacky and they chased well last time. Adds that they have had a good series leading to this one and it's nice to get on the park and play the game. Mentions that United Arab Emirates are a good team and they will have to play well to beat them.

Pitch report - A sunny morning here. The same pitch is to be used that was used on the first day. The deck has some brown patches - an area of interest for the spinners. Looks like a belter on the whole.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Waseem Muhammad, Chirag Suri, Vriitya Aravind, Rohan Mustafa, Kashif Daud, Ahmed Raza (C), Zahoor Khan, Karthik Meiyappan (In for Muhammad Usman), Junaid Siddique, Basil Hameed, Mohammad Boota (WK).

Ireland (Unchanged playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Curtis Campher, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Shane Getkate, Josh Little, Simi Singh, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Mark Adair, Craig Young.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

If you consider the match-ups for this contest, it's basically going to be between the fiery batting of Ireland and the spinners of United Arab Emirates. The Irish players have spent some time in this part of the world and have got accustomed to the conditions as well. It goes without saying that once again all the eyes will be on Paul Stirling who has been in scintillating form of late and he will hold the key. Ireland registered a thumping win in their first match and UAE also did the same. However, United Arab Emirates would have to brush up their bowling a little more. This should be a cracking contest. Stay tuned for more updates...

Hello, folks! It's a lovely morning in Al Amerat and we are getting ready for Match 1 of the Quadrangular T20I Series in Oman, 2022. This game was supposed to be the opener of this quadrangular series but due to the logistic issues, it was not possible on Friday. As you are already aware, four teams are participating here and the main aim is to get prepared for the T20 World Cup Global Qualifier Group A which is one of two global tournaments that together form the final stage of the qualification process for the 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup. So, this is very important to fine-tune your areas of improvement before the bigger challenges. Without a doubt, United Arab Emirates and Ireland are two of the better teams of this quadrangular series and their clash is the much-awaited one. Let's see who comes out trumps.
... Match Day ...
